project.name: chrysalis
project.title: Chrysalis
project.description: An engineering method for AI-assisted software work, and the stdlib Python tools that set a project up on it and check it stays there.
project.problem: Agents certify their own work; the method makes every claim carry evidence a machine or a person can check.
users: developers and teams who build software with coding agents
objectives: apply never damages an existing repository
every gate can be shown to fail
